project.name: StorySketch
project.purpose: Turn a written script into an editable, narrated whiteboard explainer video.

architecture.summary: A Next.js editor calls authenticated API routes for scene planning, SVG generation, narration, project persistence, and video rendering. OpenRouter creates scene plans and artwork, ElevenLabs creates timed narration, PostgreSQL stores projects, Vercel Blob stores media, and Remotion previews and renders the result.

components.name: StorySketch editor
components.responsibility: Collect the script, manage scenes and options, preview the composition, and start exports.

components.name: Generation API
components.responsibility: Plan scenes and generate visual and audio assets.

components.name: Render API
components.responsibility: Render the Remotion composition and publish the exported video.

concepts.name: Project
concepts.definition: A creator-owned video draft with a title, source script, voice, scenes, and optional completed render.
rules: Project access is restricted to the authenticated owner.
Saving an edit clears any prior render because the render no longer matches the project.

concepts.name: Scene
concepts.definition: An ordered section of the script with selectable artwork, narration, and drawing timing.
rules: A scene can have three generated visual options.
Narration duration retimes the drawing strokes.

concepts.name: Visual option
concepts.definition: One generated SVG interpretation of a scene in a named variation style.
rules: The editor requests Minimal, Story, and Process options in parallel.

concepts.name: Render
concepts.definition: A downloadable MP4 that represents a specific saved project signature.
rules: A completed render is saved only when project ID and render signature are supplied.

entryPoints.name: Create scenes from script
entryPoints.trigger: Creator submits a non-empty project script
entryPoints.summary: Plans scenes, then starts visual and narration generation.

entryPoints.name: Edit project
entryPoints.trigger: Creator changes project or scene content
entryPoints.summary: Updates the current draft and autosaves it.

entryPoints.name: Export video
entryPoints.summary: Starts a streamed remote render and returns a download URL.

behaviors.name: Create a whiteboard explainer
behaviors.goal: Convert a source script into an editable sequence of illustrated and narrated scenes.
behaviors.trigger: A creator submits a non-empty script.
behaviors.outcome: The editor contains planned scenes with selectable whiteboard visuals, narration, synchronized drawing timing, and a preview.

stages.name: Script submitted
stages.summary: The creator starts scene creation with a title and script.

stages.name: Plan storyboard scenes
stages.summary: The system asks OpenRouter for an ordered scene plan and validates the result.

stages.name: Generate scene visuals
stages.summary: The system generates three SVG options for each scene and converts each SVG into drawable strokes.

stages.name: Generate scene narration
stages.summary: The system creates timed speech, stores the audio, and fits drawing time to its duration.

stages.name: Explainer draft ready
stages.summary: The scenes can be reviewed as one Remotion composition.

alternatePaths: A creator can regenerate one scene or select a different visual option without rebuilding the full project.
failureModes: Empty scripts are rejected in the editor.
Generation errors are recorded on the affected scene.

behaviors.name: Save and restore a project
behaviors.goal: Preserve a creator's current editing state for later work.
behaviors.trigger: The editor loads or the creator changes the current project.
behaviors.outcome: The creator sees the latest owned project and edits are stored after a short delay.

stages.name: Owned projects requested
stages.summary: The editor requests the creator's projects and selects the most recently updated one.

stages.name: Project changed
stages.summary: The creator changes project, scene, voice, visual, or audio state.

stages.name: Save project draft
stages.summary: The editor sends a sanitized draft after the autosave delay.

stages.name: Project draft stored
stages.summary: The latest editor state is available for a later session.

alternatePaths: If no project exists, the editor creates a starter project.
The creator can create, switch, or delete projects.
failureModes: Requests without an authenticated session are rejected.
A project outside the creator's ownership is not returned or changed.

behaviors.name: Export a whiteboard video
behaviors.goal: Create a downloadable MP4 from the current project composition.
behaviors.outcome: A public video URL is returned and associated with the matching project version.

stages.name: Video export requested
stages.summary: The editor sends the current Remotion composition and project identity.

stages.name: Render project video
stages.summary: A Vercel sandbox renders all scene sequences as an H.264 video while progress streams to the editor.

stages.name: Publish rendered video
stages.summary: The system uploads the rendered file to Vercel Blob and saves its URL for the matching project version.

stages.name: Video export ready
stages.summary: The editor shows the completed export for download.

failureModes: Render errors are streamed to the editor.
The sandbox is stopped after success or failure.
